en.subtitle: Recording, venues, event management, and ticketing for your ministry and community events
en.ctaDescription: Contact us today to discuss your recording or event needs. Our team is ready to help you create something amazing.

items.title: Recording Studio
items.description: Professional recording facilities with state-of-the-art equipment. Perfect for gospel artists, choirs, and worship leaders.

items.title: Event Hall
items.description: Spacious event venue ideal for concerts, worship nights, and gospel events. Fully equipped with sound system and lighting.

items.title: Event Management
items.description: End-to-end planning and coordination for gospel concerts, worship nights, conferences, and special church events.

items.title: Ticketing Services
items.description: Reliable ticket setup and sales support for your events, including online and physical distribution options.

sw.subtitle: Kurekodi, ukumbi, usimamizi wa matukio, na huduma za tiketi kwa huduma na jamii yako
sw.ctaDescription: Wasiliana nasi leo kujadili mahitaji yako ya kurekodi au tukio. Timu yetu iko tayari kukusaidia kuunda kitu cha kipekee.

items.title: Studio ya Kurekodi
items.description: Vifaa vya kitaalamu vya kurekodi na vifaa vya kisasa. Inafaa kwa wasanii wa injili, kwaya, na viongozi wa ibada.

items.title: Ukumbi wa Matukio
items.description: Ukumbi mkubwa wa matukio unaolingana na tamasha, usiku wa ibada, na matukio ya injili. Umejengwa kikamilifu na mfumo wa sauti na taa.

items.title: Usimamizi wa Matukio
items.description: Mipango na uratibu wa mwisho hadi mwisho kwa tamasha za injili, usiku wa ibada, makongamano, na matukio maalum ya kanisa.
features: Upangaji wa programu na ratiba ya tukio
Uratibu wa watoa huduma na usafirishaji
Uendeshaji wa jukwaa na msaada wa siku ya tukio

items.title: Huduma za Tiketi
items.description: Usanidi wa tiketi na msaada wa mauzo kwa matukio yako, ikiwemo usambazaji wa mtandaoni na wa ana kwa ana.
features: Usanidi wa tiketi na mpangilio wa bei
Usambazaji wa tiketi mtandaoni na wa ana kwa ana
Uthibitishaji wa kuingia na msaada kwa wageni
Ufuatiliaji wa mauzo na ripoti ya mahudhurio
